info.name: Master Authentication Truth Matrix v2 - Auth Business Scenarios
info.description: Full authentication QA/regression collection. Folders are business scenarios TC-01 through TC-60, not endpoint groups. Scripts manage dynamic TTL simulation, refresh/retry, idle timeout, refresh locks, and logChain output.

item.name: TC-01_Guest_Token_Creation
item.description:
Scenario: Guest Token Creation
Type: Positive
Expected: Guest token is issued
Feasibility: Real
Requests are intentionally repeated so this business scenario can be run independently.

exec: pm.variables.set('scenarioMessage', "Guest token is issued | Type: Positive | Feasibility: Real");
if (current === undefined || current === null || current === '') { pm.environment.set(key, fallback); return fallback; }

Object.entries({ accessTTL: '300000', refreshTTL: '300000', idleTTL: '600000', tokenExpireTime: '0', refreshExpireTime: '0', idleExpireTime: '0', logChain: '', refreshLock: 'false', refreshAttemptCount: '0', retryAttemptCount: '0', forceAccessExpired: 'false', forceRefreshExpired: 'false', forceIdleExpired: 'false' }).forEach(([key, value]) => envGet(key, value));

function readJson() { try { return pm.response.json(); } catch (e) { return {}; } }
if (cur && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(cur, key)) { cur = cur[key]; } else { cur = undefined; break; }
